en: A black-and-white vintage postcard showing a European street scene. The image depicts the Hauptstraße (Main Street) and market square of a town, with several multi-story buildings lining the street. There is a church with a distinctive baroque-style onion dome in the background, horse-drawn carts, and people in early 20th-century dress. Visible signs include 'Hotel zur Grünen Tanne', 'Gasthof zur Stadt', and several shop signs and clock faces. The setting is tranquil with early vehicles and period street details.
